tasks.brief:
Original independent proposal: W001-relations.md CardC (read full) and W001-baselines.md. Monic base-m f degd, heightm~N^(1/d); quadratic g coeff<=H=L_N[1/3,a]; B=L_N[1/3,b], d=delta(logN/loglogN)1/3. Generic cost gives c_r³=128(r-1)/(9r), so r3 worse than linearGNFS. Proposed smallresultant selector with coefficient penalty eta gives c³=64(r-1)(1+eta)/(9r) only if no L-scale selection loss. Beat best cited Coppersmithconstant requires eta<.4511 at tau0; with tailcosttau relation inequality ra>=b+tau+[(r-1)(1+eta)/delta+a delta]/(3b). Proposed realembedding slab tolerance epsilon=exp(-lambda logN/d),lambda1,1.5,2, or complexdisk. Ideal columns/ranks/roots must also paid. No selector run yet and no improvement.

New task: audit and develop ONE explicit selector with all counting and enumeration costs. Parent tentative objection to test: log(1/epsilon)=Theta((logN)2/3/(loglogN)1/3), much larger than log(H³)=Theta((logN)1/3(loglogN)2/3); generic uniform slab loss is L2/3, so hiding it as fixed L1/3 tau is invalid. Integer-point volume is not a rigorous count when epsilonH<1. A base-m monic f often has a large root~m; a quadratic with coefficients<=H<<m cannot cancel its leading term there, except special polynomial structure; small-root cancellations might merely generate low-rank repetitions. These are challenges, not proved universal obstructions.

Derive a precise restricted rejection or produce constructive correlated lattice family with explicit count/generation and norm bounds that evades it. Verify primary prior art (higher-degree elements known; Stevenhagen§3, BaiBrentThome rootoptimization). Do not build a full siever. A finite counting probe only if mathematically decisive after preregistration, with exact/certified roots/resultants, all scanned candidates counted; no numerical logs mistaken for rigorous root isolation. If single-root slab fails, a balanced multi-embedding integer-lattice construction is a candidate revision ONLY if its determinant/shortvectorenumeration and norm gain can be fully charged. Deliver report research/findings/H008-resultant-selector.md, optional H008-resultant-* scratch next to it. Distinguish conditional heuristic leadingconstant gain from exponent/polytime. Nothing may be promoted without independent review.
